## 1. Architectural Overview

A server-rendered monolith: a single Flask application renders HTML with Jinja2 templates and persists data in a local SQLite file. There is no separate SPA or API tier. This is the smallest design that satisfies every requirement and fits the "minimalist UI" and "suitable for agentic code generation" constraints (NFR-01).

### 1.1 Technology Choices

| Concern | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Language / runtime | Python 3.11+ (3.14 present on dev machine) | Available locally; no extra toolchain. |
| Web framework | Flask 3.x | Minimal, well understood, built-in signed-cookie sessions, easy 403 handling. |
| Templating | Jinja2 (bundled with Flask) | Auto-escaping gives XSS protection by default. |
| Database | SQLite via stdlib `sqlite3` | Zero setup, no native build, adequate for scope. |
| Password hashing | `werkzeug.security` (scrypt/PBKDF2 salted hash) | NFR-03; ships with Flask. |
| CSRF protection | Per-session token checked on all POST requests (small in-house helper) | Avoids extra dependency; state-changing routes are POST-only. |
| Frontend | Plain HTML + one CSS file + ~20 lines vanilla JS (debounced search, delete confirm) | No build step; NFR-01. |
| Tests | `pytest` with Flask test client | Verifies ACs without booting a server (Step 7). |

Dependencies are limited to `Flask` and `pytest`.

### 1.2 Context Diagram

```
Browser  --HTTP (HTML forms, GET/POST)-->  Flask app  --sqlite3-->  blog.db (file)
                                              |
                                  signed session cookie (user_id, last_active)
```

## 2. Component Design

| Component | Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| App factory | `app/__init__.py` | Create Flask app, load config, register blueprints, error handlers, DB teardown, `before_request` hooks. |
| Config | `app/config.py` | `SECRET_KEY` (from env, dev fallback only in debug), DB path, `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=30`, `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH=8`. |
| Database layer | `app/db.py` | Connection per request (`g`), `init_db()` runs `schema.sql`, enables `PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON`. |
| Auth blueprint | `app/auth.py` | Register, login, logout routes; `login_required` decorator; session-timeout enforcement; CSRF helper. |
| Blog blueprint | `app/blog.py` | Feed (search + sort), detail, create, edit, delete; author-ownership check. |
| Templates | `app/templates/` | `base.html` (nav, flash messages, logout), `auth/*.html`, `blog/*.html`, `errors/*.html`. |
| Static assets | `app/static/` | `style.css`, `app.js`. |
| Schema | `app/schema.sql` | DDL for `user` and `post`. |

### 2.1 Cross-Cutting Behaviors

**Session & timeout (US-103).** The Flask session cookie stores `user_id` and `last_active` (UTC epoch seconds). A `before_request` hook runs for every request: if `last_active` is older than 30 minutes it clears the session, flashes "Session expired", and redirects to Login; otherwise it refreshes `last_active`. The cookie is a browser-session cookie (no explicit `permanent` lifetime beyond the server-side check) so refresh and new tabs retain the session (AC1) while all tabs share it and logout in one tab ends it everywhere (Q6). Cookie flags: `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Secure` when not in debug.

**Authorization (NFR-02).** Edit and delete handlers load the post, compare `post.author_id` to `session.user_id`, and `abort(403)` on mismatch before touching data. Templates also hide Edit/Delete for non-authors (defence in depth, not the control).

**Access policy (Q4 default).** All routes except register and login require authentication; unauthenticated requests redirect to Login.

**CSRF.** A random token is stored in the session and embedded in every form; POST handlers reject missing/mismatched tokens with 400.

**Error handling.** Custom 403, 404, 500 pages. Validation errors re-render the form with messages and preserved input (HTTP 200/400 as noted below).

## 3. Data Model

### 3.1 Tables

**`user`**

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT |
| `username` | TEXT | NOT NULL, `COLLATE NOCASE`, UNIQUE |
| `email` | TEXT | NOT NULL, `COLLATE NOCASE`, UNIQUE |
| `password_hash` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL, ISO-8601 UTC |

**`post`**

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT |
| `author_id` | INTEGER | NOT NULL, FK -> `user(id)` |
| `title` | TEXT | NOT NULL, length 1-150 (checked in app) |
| `content` | TEXT | NOT NULL, length 1-10,000 (checked in app) |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL, ISO-8601 UTC |
| `updated_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL, ISO-8601 UTC; equals `created_at` on creation, set on every edit |

Index: `idx_post_updated_at` on `post(updated_at DESC)`.

### 3.2 Relationships

`user` 1 --- N `post`. Account deletion is out of scope (Q15), so no cascade behavior is needed.

### 3.3 Query Safety

All SQL uses parameterized queries. Sort options map to a fixed whitelist of `ORDER BY` clauses, never interpolated from user input. Search terms are bound parameters with `LIKE ? ESCAPE '\'` and `%`/`_` escaped.

## 4. Routes / API Endpoints

HTML endpoints (server-rendered). "Auth" = login required.

| Method | Path | Auth | Purpose | Success | Failure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | Yes | Home feed; query params `q` (search), `sort` | 200 | 302 to Login |
| GET | `/auth/register` | No | Registration form | 200 | - |
| POST | `/auth/register` | No | Create account | 302 to Login | 400 re-render with errors (empty fields, short password, duplicate username/email) |
| GET | `/auth/login` | No | Login form | 200 | - |
| POST | `/auth/login` | No | Authenticate | 302 to `/` | 401 re-render, generic "Invalid credentials" |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | Yes | End session | 302 to Login | - |
| GET | `/blog/<id>` | Yes | Full reading view | 200 | 404 |
| GET | `/blog/create` | Yes | Blank form | 200 | 302 to Login |
| POST | `/blog/create` | Yes | Create post | 302 to `/blog/<id>` | 400 re-render with errors |
| GET | `/blog/<id>/edit` | Yes (author) | Pre-populated form | 200 | 403 non-author, 404 |
| POST | `/blog/<id>/edit` | Yes (author) | Update post, set `updated_at` | 302 to `/blog/<id>` | 400, 403, 404 |
| POST | `/blog/<id>/delete` | Yes (author) | Delete post | 302 to `/` | 403, 404 |

**Feed parameters.** `q`: case-insensitive substring match on title or content. `sort` whitelist: `date_desc` (default), `date_asc`, `title_asc`, `title_desc`. Search and sort combine. Unknown `sort` values fall back to `date_desc`. Empty result renders "No blogs found".

**Snippet.** Server computes the first 150 characters of content with an ellipsis when truncated (Q9).

## 5. Security Considerations

| Threat | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Plain-text passwords (NFR-03) | Salted hash via `werkzeug.security.generate_password_hash`; verified with `check_password_hash`. Never logged or rendered. |
| Broken access control (NFR-02) | Server-side ownership check on edit/delete GET and POST; 403 response. |
| User enumeration | Login returns the same message for unknown user and wrong password. (Registration necessarily reveals duplicates per US-101-AC3.) |
| SQL injection | Parameterized queries only; whitelisted sort. |
| XSS | Jinja2 auto-escape on; no `|safe` on user content; content rendered as plain text with line breaks preserved via CSS `white-space: pre-wrap`. |
| CSRF | Session-bound token on all POST routes; `SameSite=Lax`. |
| Session fixation / theft | Session cleared and rebuilt on login; `HttpOnly`/`Secure`/`SameSite` flags; 30-minute inactivity expiry. |
| Secret management | `SECRET_KEY` read from environment; app refuses to start in non-debug mode without it. |
| Brute-force login | Not mitigated (out of minimalist scope); noted as residual risk. |

## 7. Requirements Traceability

| Story | Satisfied by |
|---|---|
| US-101 Registration | `auth.register`, `user` table UNIQUE NOCASE constraints, client `required`/`minlength` attributes plus server validation |
| US-102 Login | `auth.login`, `check_password_hash`, username-or-email lookup (case-insensitive) |
| US-103 Session & Logout | Session cookie + `before_request` inactivity check; `auth.logout` (POST) with visible nav button |
| US-201 Feed | `blog.index`, `blog/index.html` cards (title, author via JOIN, `updated_at`, snippet), link to `blog.detail` |
| US-202 Search | `q` parameter, debounced `app.js` auto-submit, empty-state template block |
| US-203 Sort | `sort` whitelist, `<select>` control that submits on change |
| US-301 Create | `blog.create`, nav link shown only when authenticated, `author_id` from session |
| US-302 Edit | `blog.edit` with ownership check and `updated_at` update; Edit button conditional on authorship |
| US-303 Delete | `blog.delete` (POST) with ownership check; JS `confirm()` plus server-side authorization |
| NFR-01 UI | Single stylesheet, no framework, no build step |
| NFR-02 RBAC | Ownership check -> 403 |
| NFR-03 Passwords | Hashed storage |
| NFR-04 Timeout | `before_request` hook with `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=30` |
| NFR-05 Scope | No uploads, OTP, or rich editor components in design |

## 8. Decisions on Open Questions from Step 1

The proposed defaults in `requirements.md` section 5 are adopted, with these architecture-relevant points: Q2 password min 8; Q3/Q16 NOCASE uniqueness and lookup; Q4 login required for feed and detail; Q5 any request refreshes the timer; Q7/Q8 default sort by `updated_at` desc; Q9 150-char snippet; Q10 combined, case-insensitive substring search; Q11 redirect to new post; Q12 title <=150, content <=10,000; Q13 server returns 403; Q14 no pagination.

**Known trade-offs:** Server-rendered pages mean search triggers a page reload (debounced) rather than in-place filtering; acceptable under US-202-AC2 ("real time or upon submission"). SQLite limits write concurrency, which is acceptable at this scale. Because the cookie is signed rather than encrypted, only non-sensitive identifiers are stored in it.
